slug: 2025-08-28 Nigeria to launch National Data Exchange (NGDX) platform to boost digital economy

facts.fact: The Nigerian government is preparing to launch the NGDX data-sharing platform between government agencies and businesses, expected operational by end 2025, as discussed at an Abuja workshop on 25 August 2025.

NGA.note: NGDX is named but nothing is stated about social protection systems exchanging data.
